reference.title: Code block rendering
reference.shortdesc: Set DITA codeblock output classes to choose the syntax highlighter and optional line numbers.

section.title: Set a language
section.p: Use outputclass="language-name" to select a language. The plug-in renders codeblocks as fenced code through pymdownx.superfences, using the project's pymdownx.highlight settings.
The generated code uses Zensical's highlighting styles, copy button, and line anchors. Add show-line-numbers to display line numbers. The codeblock's DITA ID and other classes are retained.

ul.li: dita, ditamap, and ditaval use XML highlighting.
A codeblock without a language uses zensical.code.default-lang, which defaults to plain text.
An unrecognized language falls back to plain text and produces a build warning.

section.title: Formatting inside codeblocks
section.p: When a language is set, inline formatting such as <b> or <varname> is replaced by syntax token colors. Without a language, DITA formatting markup is retained. A codeblock with a link or image keeps its HTML inside the code box and is not syntax-colored.
